title: Old-timers he played with or missed
summary: He played with Father Al and sat in with Buddy Petit but was too young for Jack Perry.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Are there any other bands you can think of that you played with? Any musicians in particular that you like that you worked with? Well... Especially the old timers. Yeah. We're trying to get into that old history as much as we can, of course. That's true.
Well, most of the old timers I played with when I was really young, one of them was a kind of player, by the name of Father Al, you heard of him?
Yeah. I played with him in a band during the time they had. And they were in a band.
You never did play with Jack Perry then, I guess. Before he died, I guess quite a long time ago. I don't know who to play with Jack Perry. I was too young at the time, one of them.
But I played once or twice with Buddy Petit's band. I sat in a band. And I worked in...
